name: claude-ai-music-skills
tagline_zh: 别让Suno只会哼小样——用这套技能包，把AI旋律变成完整编曲、混音、母带，像和制作人并肩干活。
tagline_en: Stop letting Suno hum rough demos—this skill kit turns AI melodies into full mixes, with a producer's workflow.
desc_en: Human + AI music production workflow for Suno - skills, templates, and tools
why_zh: 同类工具只给提示词，它给的是人机协作流程：从灵感到成品的每一步都有模板和技能支撑，不靠运气。
why_en: Others give prompts; this gives a human-AI production pipeline—templates and skills for every step, no luck needed.

install.note: clone 下来，挑你要的那件复制进 ~/.claude/skills/。这是一个合集，没有「装它」这个动作。
